source_metadata.title: Large language model accuracy in inhaler technique counselling for asthma and COPD: A comparison of free and paid models across ten devices

known_abstract_level_findings_for_retrie.design: Cross-sectional blinded evaluation of ten LLMs across free and paid tiers.
known_abstract_level_findings_for_retrie.prompt_design: 50 standardized prompts across 10 inhaler devices and 5 question types, submitted in triplicate, yielding 1,500 outputs.
known_abstract_level_findings_for_retrie.reported_summary: Paid tiers outperformed free tiers on five of seven metrics; critical errors were reported as 0.48 versus 0.02, safety-warning coverage as 62.4% versus 75.3%, and only two metrics met ICC >= 0.75.
known_abstract_level_findings_for_retrie.use_boundary: These abstract-level facts are recorded only to confirm source identity and retrieval priority; they were not converted into LiteratureAtoms or SEA scores.
